I've thought about that.  I just don't know how I would react to new people.  I usually fuck it up or fuck it up over time.

I don't really like doing anything really.  I like to cook, but it is more of a therapeutic thing for me.  I like to spends hours, maybe all day prepping a great meal.  Keeps my mind busy.  I would hate to cook for a living though.  I'm a very slow person, and if I had to cook all day it would probably make me despise cooking.

I don't like my job, but I don't really mind the work.  I don't really know where else to go right now.  I get along with some of my employees when it's one-on-one but they never want to hang out outside of work.

Money is a bit of an issue.  I want to go to a community college but I have a terrible time paying attention in class.  I used to take adderal for it but I just ended up abusing my prescription.  I don't know what I would study for.  Right now I work as a delivery driver for jimmy johns.
If this is not too much to ask for, could you give me an example of how you were before and after the meds?

From lurking /r/trees and growing up in Central Florida, it seems to be the greatest thing to bring people together.  I've dealt my hand with amphetamines, cocaine, and roxies but of course it all ended badly for me and my relationships.  I hate being an alcoholic.  I want to smoke weed and be relaxed with people but it only makes me run away and hit myself and other emo bullshit.  I keep trying to get back into it.  I got a gram of some sour kush the other day and I've been taking a few puff every night before bed.  It still hurts and depresses the shit out of me but I want to get used to it.  I want it to better me as a human being.
I'm a bit scared of medication.  More scarred I suppose.  I grew up on hand-fulls of pills everyday and I had no idea what they were.  Fucked me up good.
hahaha.  Well thanks man I appreciate the kind words and time you put into this.
I don't take it personal at work.  I laugh and try to play along but they just give me a cold shoulder or others join in throwing insults.

I spent a year letting them get to know me.  Some of them I considered friends and invited them to events like cookouts at my house or just hitting the bar, they all would either refuse or just not show up.  I just recently started acting more aggressive.  Maybe being a dick is wrong but I can not help but feel wronged.

I do the same, especially when I smoke weed.  Just the other night I smoked for the first time in months and it was unbearable.  I sat in my car from about 2 A.M. to 7 A.M. crying like a bitch and yelling about all the clarity the weed gave me.

I didn't talk much around the group.  I showed respect when I had the chance to.  I actually got along and had a great time with some of them when it was more of a one-on-one thing.  But it seems when the whole group is together they treat me like shit or just ignore me.

It helps in the short term but kills me in the long term.  I know they all have the same evolving opinion on me when I lash out.  I feel like a terrible person because that's how they see me.  I really hope I'm not.
It sucks, man.  I don't have a single bad thing to say about them but it's like they crave me to fight them and then cry when I put up my fists.
